description: Panels backed by metrics that /metrics exports today have data right after import. Panels with an information note wait for aggregate metrics the process does not export yet: the Repositories row, pack cache bytes, disk free, uptime, active repositories, top-10 share and the two backoff counts. To change the dashboard, edit it in Grafana, export the JSON and replace dashboards/git-cdn.json in the repository.
